hook: Ek Shishya Jisne Guru Ko Angootha De Diya

points.title: Guru ne mana kiya
points.text: Mahabharat ke anusaar, Drona ne Ekalavya ko shishya nahi banaya.

points.title: Mitti ki murti
points.text: Usne Drona ki mitti ki murti banakar roz abhyaas kiya.

points.title: Kutte ka munh band
points.text: Bhaunkte kutte ke munh mein saat teer, bina chot pahunchaye.

points.title: Guru dakshina
points.text: Drona ne daayan angootha maanga. Ekalavya ne turant de diya.

takeaway: Lagan aur samarpan ki misaal, jo aaj bhi yaad ki jaati hai.
cta: Follow karo, har raat ek kahani
